difficulty_reason: The non-routine mechanism extracts a balanced hard distribution with a one-sided noisy typical leaf property from expected-query minimax. It amplifies that property to many coordinates and simulates noisy leaves by low-degree conical juntas for GapOr, yielding the exact majority composition cost.
